description: This file defines the LatinKeyboard class, a custom implementation extending Android's Keyboard class, used for managing keyboard layout, keys, and their behaviors within an Android soft keyboard application. It handles dynamic key visibility, setting IME options, and managing key-specific actions.

classes.name: LatinKeyboard
classes.description: A custom keyboard class managing layout and keys for a soft keyboard, including dynamic visibility of certain keys like language switch and mode change, and setting IME options.

classes.name: LatinKeyboard.LatinKey
classes.description: A subclass of Keyboard.Key with overridden isInside method to customize target area for specific keys.

methods.name: LatinKeyboard
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LatinKeyboard with provided layout resource or template.

methods.name: createKeyFromXml
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LatinKey instance from XML parser, assigning special keys for enter, space, mode change, and language switch.

methods.name: setLanguageSwitchKeyVisibility
methods.description: Dynamically shows or hides the language switch key, adjusting related keys' sizes and icons accordingly.

methods.name: setImeOptions
methods.description: Sets the label and icon of the enter key based on IME options from the editor.

methods.name: setSpaceIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon drawable for the space key.
